r8.method: Two independent supervised 179409-parameter RGB/color-outline CNNs. AdamW; MSE plus 0.25 worst-quartile MSE; balanced motion, size and episode sampling. No RL or cross-model loss.

r9.method: Independent supervised RGB/color-outline models, same regenerated crops and all original gates; absolute table XY context zeroed. Known geometry remains. AdamW MSE plus worst-quartile MSE; no cross-model loss or reserved data.

r10.method: Independent supervised RGB/color-outline CNNs, geometry only (no absolute XY context); AdamW MSE plus 0.25 worst-quartile MSE, balanced motion/size/episode sampling. Additional 36 physically measured training-only midfill episodes. No RL or cross-model loss.

r11.method: Independent supervised RGB/color-outline CNNs, geometry only (no absolute XY context); AdamW MSE plus 0.25 worst-quartile MSE, balanced motion/size/episode sampling. Camera-consistent random XY crop perturbation within 2 mm, matching the observed localization envelope. Color mask/edges recomputed after perturbing RGB. No RL or cross-model loss.

r12.method: Independent supervised RGB/color-outline CNNs, geometry-only context; AdamW MSE plus 0.25 worst-quartile MSE, balanced motion/size/episode sampling. All crops rebuilt from tracker-t3; each initialization chosen by the retained development score between r10/r11, never reserved data.

r13.method: Independent supervised RGB/color-outline CNNs, AdamW MSE plus 0.25 worst-quartile MSE. Each balanced training sample chooses its original crop or one of two native-camera XY-perturbed crops. No second resampling; color features computed after selection. Original train/validation images and all acceptance gates remain unchanged.

r14.method: Separate supervised rim/surface heatmap CNNs for RGB and color-outline inputs. Gaussian heatmap cross entropy + 0.2 point smooth-L1 + 40*(level MSE + 0.25 worst-quartile MSE). Calibrated image rays reconstruct normalized liquid height. Native train-only crop alternatives; no validation gradients or reserved images.
